_comment: What a realm is seeded with the first time this server starts, before an
operator has changed anything. Every value here is editable afterwards
from the admin settings page; this file only decides where a fresh
It lives here, in version control, rather than as constants in
src/server/src/admin.rs (spec 032 T014a3). Seeding a realm is
configuration, and `default_game_system_id` in particular was the last
system identifier written into shared server code — the exact thing
FR-029 and scripts/check-system-registry.mjs exist to keep out of it.
It cannot live in src/server/data: that directory is gitignored, so a
file there ships with no install and every new world would come out with
no system at all. It is compiled in with include_str! for the same
reason — a seed that can go missing at runtime is a seed that will.
